quote:
[p1] When a large feedforward neural network is trained on a small training set, it typically performs poorly on held-out test data.
[p2] the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：当大型前馈神经网络在小型训练集上训练时，通常在留出测试数据上表现很差，即过拟合 [p1][p2]。

quote: the feature detectors have been tuned to work well together on the training data but not on the test data.
claim: 作者指出，过拟合的原因是特征检测器被调整成在训练数据上协同工作良好，但在测试数据上并非如此 [p2]。

quote: On each presentation of each training case, each hidden unit is randomly omitted from the network with a probability of 0.5, so a hidden unit cannot rely on other hidden units being present.
claim: 论文提出 dropout：在每次呈现每个训练样本时，每个隐藏单元以 0.5 的概率被随机从网络中省略，使隐藏单元不能依赖其他隐藏单元的存在 [p3]。

quote: we set an upper bound on the L2 norm of the incoming weight vector for each individual hidden unit.
claim: 训练使用标准随机梯度下降，但将通常的权重惩罚改为对每个隐藏单元输入权重向量的 L2 范数设置上界，若权重更新违反该约束则通过除法重新归一化 [p4]。

quote: At test time, we use the “mean network” that contains all of the hidden units but with their outgoing weights halved
claim: 测试时使用包含所有隐藏单元但输出权重减半的“mean network” [p5]。

quote:
[p6] It contains 60,000 28x28 training images of individual hand written digits and 10,000 test images.
[p8] We then applied dropout to TIMIT, a widely used benchmark for recognition of clean speech with a small vocabulary.
[p10] These images were labeled by hand to produce 50,000 training images and 10,000 test images
[p11] ImageNet is an extremely challenging object recognition dataset consisting of thousands of high-resolution images of thousands of classes of object.
[p13] We created training and test sets each containing 201,369 documents from 50 mutually exclusive classes.
claim: 论文在多个基准数据集上评估 dropout：MNIST 手写数字识别（60,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p6][A1.SS1.p1]、TIMIT 干净语音识别 [p8]、CIFAR-10 物体识别（50,000 训练图像、10,000 测试图像）[p10]、ImageNet 物体识别 [p11] 以及 Reuters 文档分类（201,369 篇文档、50 个互斥类别）[p13]。

quote: We made these decisions by holding out a separate validation set that was used to evaluate the performance of a large number of different architectures
claim: 对于语音识别和两个物体识别数据集，作者通过留出验证集来选择网络架构，再用在验证集上表现最好的架构评估 dropout 在真实测试集上的性能 [p12]。

quote: the best published result for a standard feedforward neural network is 160 errors on the test set.
claim: 在 MNIST 上，不使用任何技巧时标准前馈神经网络的最佳已发表结果为 160 个测试错误，使用 50% dropout 和每个隐藏单元输入权重的独立 L2 约束可降至约 130 个错误，再随机丢弃 20% 像素可进一步降至约 110 个错误 [p6]。

quote: Without dropout, the recognition rate is $22.7$ % and with dropout this improves to $19.7$ %, which is a record for methods that do not use any information about speaker identity.
claim: 在 TIMIT 上，无 dropout 时识别率为 22.7%，使用 dropout 后提升至 19.7%，这是不使用说话人身份信息的方法中的记录 [p9]。

quote: The best published error rate on the test set, without using transformed data, is 18.5%.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，不使用变换数据的最佳已发表错误率为 18.5%，作者达到 16.6%，在最后一个隐藏层使用 dropout 后达到 15.6% [p10]。

quote: We achieved comparable performance of 48.6% error using a single neural network
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，作者用单个神经网络达到 48.6% 错误率，在第六个隐藏层使用 50% dropout 后降至创纪录的 42.4% [p11]。

quote: A feedforward neural network with 2 fully connected layers of 2000 hidden units trained with backpropagation gets 31.05% error on the test set.
claim: 在 Reuters 上，标准反向传播的错误率为 31.05%，使用 50% dropout 后降至 29.62% [p13]。

quote: Driven by the significance of depth, a question arises: Is learning better networks as easy as stacking more layers?
claim: 论文要回答的问题是：学习更好的网络是否像堆叠更多层一样简单 [S1.p2]。

quote: When deeper networks are able to start converging, a degradation problem has been exposed: with the network depth increasing, accuracy gets saturated (which might be unsurprising) and then degrades rapidly.
claim: 作者指出，当更深的网络能够开始收敛时，会出现退化问题：随着深度增加，准确率饱和并迅速下降，且这种退化并非由过拟合引起，向适当深的模型添加更多层会导致更高的训练误差 [S1.p3]。

quote: The degradation (of training accuracy) indicates that not all systems are similarly easy to optimize.
claim: 作者认为退化表明并非所有系统都同样容易优化 [S1.p4]。

quote: Instead of hoping each few stacked layers directly fit a desired underlying mapping, we explicitly let these layers fit a residual mapping.
claim: 论文提出深度残差学习框架：不期望每几个堆叠层直接拟合目标底层映射 H(x)，而是显式地让这些层拟合残差映射 F(x):=H(x)-x，原始映射被重写为 F(x)+x [S1.p5]。

quote: The formulation of $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})+\mathbf{x}$ can be realized by feedforward neural networks with “shortcut connections” (Fig. 2).
claim: 该形式通过前馈神经网络中的“捷径连接”实现，捷径连接执行恒等映射，其输出加到堆叠层的输出上，且不增加额外参数或计算复杂度 [S1.p6]。

quote: But we will show by experiments that the identity mapping is sufficient for addressing the degradation problem and is economical, and thus $W_{s}$ is only used when matching dimensions.
claim: 当输入输出维度不一致时，可用线性投影 W_s 匹配维度，但实验表明恒等映射足以解决退化问题且更经济 [S3.SS2.p3]。

quote: We evaluate our method on the ImageNet 2012 classification dataset that consists of 1000 classes.
claim: 论文在 ImageNet 2012 分类数据集（1000 类，128 万训练图像，5 万验证图像，10 万测试图像）上评估方法，报告 top-1 和 top-5 误差率 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote:
[S4.SS1.p2] We first evaluate 18-layer and 34-layer plain nets.
[S4.SS1.p13] We replace each 2-layer block in the 34-layer net with this 3-layer bottleneck block, resulting in a 50-layer ResNet (Table 1).
[S4.SS1.p14] We construct 101-layer and 152-layer ResNets by using more 3-layer blocks (Table 1).
claim: 作者比较了 18 层和 34 层普通网络与残差网络，并构建了 50、101、152 层的瓶颈残差网络 [S4.SS1.p2][S4.SS1.p13][S4.SS1.p14]。

quote:
[S4.SS2.p1] We conducted more studies on the CIFAR-10 dataset, which consists of 50k training images and 10k testing images in 10 classes.
[S4.SS2.p4] We compare $n=\{3,5,7,9\}$, leading to 20, 32, 44, and 56-layer networks.
[S4.SS2.p8] We set $n=200$ that leads to a 1202-layer network, which is trained as described above.
claim: 此外，在 CIFAR-10（5 万训练图像、1 万测试图像、10 类）上进行了更多研究，训练了 20 至 1202 层的网络 [S4.SS2.p1][S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p8]。

quote: We adopt Faster R-CNN as the detection method.
claim: 还在 PASCAL VOC 和 MS COCO 上以 Faster R-CNN 为检测方法评估了目标检测性能 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: The results in Table 2 show that the deeper 34-layer plain net has higher validation error than the shallower 18-layer plain net.
claim: 在 ImageNet 上，34 层普通网络比 18 层普通网络有更高的验证误差，且在整个训练过程中训练误差更高，即出现退化问题 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote:
[S4.SS1.p6] the situation is reversed with residual learning – the 34-layer ResNet is better than the 18-layer ResNet (by 2.8%).
[S4.SS1.p7] the 34-layer ResNet reduces the top-1 error by 3.5% (Table 2)
claim: 残差学习逆转了这一情况：34 层 ResNet 比 18 层 ResNet 好 2.8%，且 34 层 ResNet 相比对应的普通网络将 top-1 误差降低了 3.5% [S4.SS1.p6][S4.SS1.p7]。

quote: The 50/101/152-layer ResNets are more accurate than the 34-layer ones by considerable margins (Table 3 and 5).
claim: 50/101/152 层 ResNet 比 34 层网络准确率更高，未观察到退化问题 [S4.SS1.p15]。

quote: Our 152-layer ResNet has a single-model top-5 validation error of 4.49%.
claim: 152 层 ResNet 单模型 top-5 验证误差为 4.49%，六模型集成在测试集上达到 3.57% top-5 误差，赢得 ILSVRC 2015 第一名 [S4.SS1.p16]。

quote:
[S4.SS2.p4] The deep plain nets suffer from increased depth, and exhibit higher training error when going deeper.
[S4.SS2.p5] our ResNets manage to overcome the optimization difficulty and demonstrate accuracy gains when the depth increases.
claim: 在 CIFAR-10 上，普通网络随深度增加训练误差升高，而 ResNet 克服了优化困难并随深度增加获得精度提升 [S4.SS2.p4][S4.SS2.p5]。

quote: this $10^{3}$ -layer network is able to achieve training error $<$ 0.1% (Fig. 6, right). Its test error is still fairly good (7.93%, Table 6).
claim: 1202 层网络训练误差低于 0.1%，测试误差为 7.93% [S4.SS2.p8]。

quote: on the challenging COCO dataset we obtain a 6.0% increase in COCO’s standard metric (mAP@[.5,.95]), which is a 28% relative improvement.
claim: 在目标检测上，用 ResNet-101 替换 VGG-16 在 COCO 上使 mAP@[.5,.95] 提高 6.0%，相对提升 28% [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
claim: 作者指出，1202 层网络虽然训练误差与 110 层网络相似，但测试结果更差，作者认为这是因为过拟合，该网络对此小数据集可能不必要地大 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The testing result of this 1202-layer network is worse than that of our 110-layer network, although both have similar training error.
claim: 作者在 CIFAR-10 上未使用 maxout/dropout，仅通过深而窄的架构施加正则化，并表示结合更强的正则化可能改善结果，留待未来研究 [S4.SS2.p9]。

quote: The reason for such optimization difficulties will be studied in the future.
claim: 此外，作者提到深度普通网络优化困难的原因尚待未来研究 [S4.SS1.p4]。

quote: This inherently sequential nature precludes parallelization within training examples, which becomes critical at longer sequence lengths
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：循环模型沿输入输出序列的符号位置逐步计算，这种固有的顺序性阻碍了训练样本内部的并行化，在序列较长时尤为关键 [S1.p2]。

quote: In all but a few cases, however, such attention mechanisms are used in conjunction with a recurrent network.
claim: 注意力机制已成为序列建模与转导模型的重要组成部分，但除少数情况外，这类注意力机制都与循环网络结合使用 [S1.p3]。

quote: we propose the Transformer, a model architecture eschewing recurrence and instead relying entirely on an attention mechanism to draw global dependencies between input and output
claim: 作者因此提出 Transformer，完全依赖注意力机制来建立输入与输出之间的全局依赖，不再使用循环 [S1.p4]。

quote:
[S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1] The encoder is composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
[S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1] We employ a residual connection around each of the two sub-layers, followed by layer normalization.
[S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1] The decoder is also composed of a stack of $N=6$ identical layers.
claim: Transformer 沿用编码器-解码器整体结构，编码器和解码器各由 N=6 个相同层堆叠而成，每层包含多头自注意力与逐位置全连接前馈网络，并采用残差连接加层归一化 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1][S3.SS1.SSS0.Px2.p1]。

quote: We compute the dot products of the query with all keys, divide each by $\sqrt{d_{k}}$, and apply a softmax function to obtain the weights on the values.
claim: 其注意力采用缩放点积注意力，将查询与所有键做点积、除以 √dk 后经 softmax 得到值的权重 [S3.SS2.SSS1.p1]；

quote:
[S3.SS2.SSS2.p1] we found it beneficial to linearly project the queries, keys and values $h$ times with different, learned linear projections
[S3.SS2.SSS2.p5] In this work we employ $h=8$ parallel attention layers, or heads.
[S3.SS2.SSS2.p5] For each of these we use $d_{k}=d_{v}=d_{\text{model}}/h=64$.
claim: 多头注意力将查询、键、值线性投影 h 次后并行执行注意力再拼接投影 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p1]，本文使用 h=8 个头，每个头 dk=dv=dmodel/h=64 [S3.SS2.SSS2.p5]。

quote:
[S3.SS5.p1] Since our model contains no recurrence and no convolution, in order for the model to make use of the order of the sequence, we must inject some information about the relative or absolute position of the tokens in the sequence.
[S3.SS5.p2] In this work, we use sine and cosine functions of different frequencies:
claim: 由于模型不含循环和卷积，作者在输入嵌入中加入正弦余弦位置编码以注入序列顺序信息 [S3.SS5.p1][S3.SS5.p2]。

quote: We trained on the standard WMT 2014 English-German dataset consisting of about 4.5 million sentence pairs.
claim: 训练数据为 WMT 2014 英德数据集（约 450 万句对，共享源目标 BPE 词表约 37000 词）和 WMT 2014 英法数据集（3600 万句，32000 word-piece 词表）[S5.SS1.p1]。

quote: We trained our models on one machine with 8 NVIDIA P100 GPUs.
claim: 模型在 8 块 NVIDIA P100 GPU 上训练，base 模型训练 100,000 步约 12 小时，big 模型训练 300,000 步约 3.5 天 [S5.SS2.p1]。

quote: We trained a 4-layer transformer with $d_{model}=1024$ on the Wall Street Journal (WSJ) portion of the Penn Treebank, about 40K training sentences.
claim: 作者还在英语成分句法分析任务上验证泛化性，使用 Penn Treebank 的 WSJ 部分约 40K 训练句，并在半监督设置下使用约 17M 句的语料 [S6.SS3.p2]。

quote: outperforms the best previously reported models (including ensembles) by more than $2.0$ BLEU, establishing a new state-of-the-art BLEU score of $28.4$
claim: 在 WMT 2014 英德翻译任务上，big 模型超过此前最佳模型（含集成模型）2.0 BLEU 以上，取得 28.4 的新 state-of-the-art BLEU 分数 [S6.SS1.p1]；

quote: our big model achieves a BLEU score of $41.0$, outperforming all of the previously published single models, at less than $1/4$ the training cost of the previous state-of-the-art model
claim: 在英法任务上，big 模型取得 41.0 BLEU，超过此前所有已发表单模型，训练成本不到此前 state-of-the-art 模型的 1/4 [S6.SS1.p2]。

quote: While single-head attention is 0.9 BLEU worse than the best setting, quality also drops off with too many heads.
claim: 模型变体实验显示，单头注意力比最佳设置差 0.9 BLEU，头数过多质量也会下降 [S6.SS2.p2]；

quote: we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality
claim: 减小注意力键维度 dk 会损害模型质量 [S6.SS2.p3]；

quote: we observe that reducing the attention key size $d_{k}$ hurts model quality
claim: 用学习式位置嵌入替换正弦位置编码得到几乎相同的结果 [S6.SS2.p3]。

quote:
[S6.SS3.p4] yielding better results than all previously reported models with the exception of the Recurrent Neural Network Grammar
[S6.SS3.p5] the Transformer outperforms the BerkeleyParser even when training only on the WSJ training set of 40K sentences
claim: 在英语成分句法分析上，尽管缺少任务特定调参，模型表现优于此前所有已报告模型，仅逊于 Recurrent Neural Network Grammar [S6.SS3.p4]，并且在仅用 40K 句 WSJ 训练集时也优于 BerkeleyParser [S6.SS3.p5]。

quote: albeit at the cost of reduced effective resolution due to averaging attention-weighted positions, an effect we counteract with Multi-Head Attention
claim: 作者指出，将注意力加权位置平均会降低有效分辨率，他们用多头注意力来抵消这一影响 [S2.p1]。

quote: self-attention could be restricted to considering only a neighborhood of size $r$ in the input sequence centered around the respective output position
claim: 对于涉及很长序列的任务，作者提出可将自注意力限制为只考虑以相应输出位置为中心、大小为 r 的邻域，并计划在未来工作中进一步研究这一方法 [S4.p4]。

quote: We plan to extend the Transformer to problems involving input and output modalities other than text and to investigate local, restricted attention mechanisms to efficiently handle large inputs and outputs such as images, audio and video.
claim: 作者还表示计划将 Transformer 扩展到文本以外的输入输出模态，并研究局部受限注意力机制以高效处理图像、音频、视频等大输入输出 [S7.p3]。

quote: However, their ability to access and precisely manipulate knowledge is still limited, and hence on knowledge-intensive tasks, their performance lags behind task-specific architectures.
claim: 论文旨在解决预训练语言模型在知识密集型任务上访问和精确操作知识能力有限、性能落后于任务特定架构的问题，以及为其决策提供来源和更新世界知识的问题 [abstract]。

quote: Hybrid models that combine parametric memory with non-parametric (i.e., retrieval-based) memories can address some of these issues because knowledge can be directly revised and expanded, and accessed knowledge can be inspected and interpreted.
claim: 作者指出，结合参数记忆与非参数记忆的混合模型可以解决部分问题，因为知识可以直接修订和扩展，访问的知识可以被检查和解释 [S1.p1]。

quote: Hybrid models that combine parametric memory with non-parametric (i.e., retrieval-based) memories can address some of these issues because knowledge can be directly revised and expanded, and accessed knowledge can be inspected and interpreted.
claim: 此前结合掩码语言模型与可微检索器的模型仅探索了开放域抽取式问答，本文希望将混合参数与非参数记忆引入序列到序列模型 [S1.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: RAG 模型使用输入序列检索文本文档，并将其作为生成目标序列的额外上下文 [S2.p1]。

quote: We explore RAG models, which use the input sequence $x$ to retrieve text documents $z$ and use them as additional context when generating the target sequence $y$.
claim: 模型包含两个组件：返回 top-K 文本段落分布的检索器 p_η(z|x)，以及基于前 i-1 个 token、原始输入和检索段落生成当前 token 的生成器 p_θ(y_i|x,z,y_{1:i-1}) [S2.p1]。

quote: The retrieval component $p_{\eta}(z|x)$ is based on DPR. DPR follows a bi-encoder architecture
claim: 检索器基于 DPR 的双编码器架构，使用 BERT_BASE 文档编码器和查询编码器，通过最大内积搜索（MIPS）近似求解 top-k [S2.SS2.p1]。

quote: We use BART-large, a pre-trained seq2seq transformer with 400M parameters. To combine the input $x$ with the retrieved content $z$ when generating from BART, we simply concatenate them.
claim: 生成器使用 BART-large，将输入与检索内容拼接 [S2.SS3.p1]。

quote: We jointly train the retriever and generator components without any direct supervision on what document should be retrieved.
claim: 训练时联合训练检索器和生成器，无需对检索文档的直接监督，固定文档编码器和索引，仅微调查询编码器和 BART 生成器 [S2.SS4.p1]。

quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
claim: 实验使用 2018 年 12 月的 Wikipedia dump 作为非参数知识源，每篇文章切分为不重叠的 100 词块，共 2100 万文档，使用 FAISS 构建 MIPS 索引 [S3.p1]。

quote: For all experiments, we use a single Wikipedia dump for our non-parametric knowledge source.
claim: 训练时检索 top k 文档，k 取 5 或 10，测试时的 k 由开发集确定 [S3.p1]。

quote:
[S3.SS1.p1] We consider four popular open-domain QA datasets: Natural Questions (NQ), TriviaQA (TQA). WebQuestions (WQ) and CuratedTrec (CT).
[S3.SS2.p1] To test RAG’s natural language generation (NLG) in a knowledge-intensive setting, we use the MSMARCO NLG task v2.1.
[S3.SS3.p1] To evaluate RAG’s generation abilities in a non-QA setting, we study open-domain question generation.
[S3.SS4.p1] FEVER requires classifying whether a natural language claim is supported or refuted by Wikipedia, or whether there is not enough information to decide.
claim: 评估任务包括开放域问答（NQ、TriviaQA、WebQuestions、CuratedTrec）[S3.SS1.p1]、抽象问答（MSMARCO NLG v2.1）[S3.SS2.p1]、Jeopardy 问题生成 [S3.SS3.p1] 和 FEVER 事实核查 [S3.SS4.p1]。

quote: On all four open-domain QA tasks, RAG sets a new state of the art (only on the T5-comparable split for TQA).
claim: 在四个开放域问答任务上，RAG 均取得新的最优结果（TriviaQA 仅在 T5 可比划分上）[S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: On all four open-domain QA tasks, RAG sets a new state of the art (only on the T5-comparable split for TQA).
claim: RAG 无需重排序器或抽取式阅读器即可达到最优性能 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote: RAG-Sequence outperforms BART on Open MS-MARCO NLG by 2.6 Bleu points and 2.6 Rouge-L points.
claim: 在 MS-MARCO NLG 上，RAG-Sequence 比 BART 高 2.6 Bleu 点和 2.6 Rouge-L 点 [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 在 Jeopardy 问题生成上，RAG-Token 优于 RAG-Sequence，两者均优于 BART 的 Q-BLEU-1 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: RAG-Token performs better than RAG-Sequence on Jeopardy question generation, with both models outperforming BART on Q-BLEU-1.
claim: 人类评估中，仅 7.1% 的案例认为 BART 比 RAG 更符合事实，而 42.7% 的案例认为 RAG 更符合事实 [S4.SS3.p1]。

quote: For 3-way classification, RAG scores are within 4.3% of state-of-the-art models
claim: 在 FEVER 三分类上，RAG 与最优模型差距在 4.3% 以内 [S4.SS4.p1]。

quote: RAG-Sequence’s generations are more diverse than RAG-Token’s, and both are significantly more diverse than BART without needing any diversity-promoting decoding.
claim: RAG 的生成比 BART 更多样 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: This shows we can update RAG’s world knowledge by simply replacing its non-parametric memory.
claim: 通过替换非参数记忆索引，可以更新 RAG 的世界知识 [S4.SS5.SSS0.Px3.p1]。

quote: In preliminary experiments, we observed that for some tasks such as story generation, the retrieval component would “collapse” and learn to retrieve the same documents regardless of the input.
claim: 作者指出，在初步实验中，对于故事生成等任务，检索组件会“崩溃”并学会检索相同的文档，此时生成器学会忽略文档，RAG 模型表现与 BART 相当 [A8.p1]。

quote: As FEVER uses a different Wikipedia dump to us, directly tackling this task is not straightforward. We hope to address this in future work.
claim: FEVER 的另一个子任务涉及从 Wikipedia 抽取句子作为支持分类预测的证据，但由于 FEVER 使用了不同的 Wikipedia dump，直接处理该任务并不简单，作者希望在未来工作中解决 [A5.p1]。

quote: In future work, it may be fruitful to investigate if the two components can be jointly pre-trained from scratch, either with a denoising objective similar to BART or some another objective.
claim: 作者还提到，未来工作可以研究是否能用类似 BART 的去噪目标或其他目标从头联合预训练两个组件 [S6.p1]。

quote: there is still a need for task-specific datasets and task-specific fine-tuning
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：现有预训练加微调的范式虽然架构任务无关，但仍需要每个任务数千到数十万条任务特定标注数据进行微调 [S1.p2]。

quote:
[S1.p3] the need for a large dataset of labeled examples for every new task limits the applicability of language models
[S1.p5] humans do not require large supervised datasets to learn most language tasks
claim: 作者指出，为每个新任务收集大规模监督数据集限制了语言模型的适用性 [S1.p3]，而人类通常只需简短指令或极少量示例就能完成新语言任务 [S1.p5]。

quote:
[abstract] scaling up language models greatly improves task-agnostic, few-shot performance
[S1.p9] we test this hypothesis by training a 175 billion parameter autoregressive language model
claim: 因此论文测试的假设是：扩大语言模型规模能否大幅提升任务无关的少样本性能 [abstract][S1.p9]。

quote: we train 8 different sizes of model, ranging over three orders of magnitude from 125 million parameters to 175 billion parameters
claim: 论文训练了 8 个不同规模的模型，参数从 1.25 亿到 1750 亿，其中最大者称为 GPT-3，架构与 GPT-2 相同但使用交替的稠密和局部带状稀疏注意力 [S2.SS1.p1]。

quote:
[S2.SS2.p1] we downloaded and filtered a version of CommonCrawl based on similarity to a range of high-quality reference corpora
[S2.SS2.p2] we added several curated high-quality datasets, including an expanded version of the WebText dataset
claim: 训练数据以过滤后的 Common Crawl 为主，并加入 WebText、Books1、Books2 和英文维基百科等高质量语料 [S2.SS2.p1][S2.SS2.p2]。

quote:
[abstract] GPT-3 is applied without any gradient updates or fine-tuning
[S2.p2] the model is given a few demonstrations of the task at inference time as conditioning, but no weight updates are allowed
claim: 评估时不做梯度更新或微调，而是通过文本交互给出任务描述和少量示例，分为零样本、单样本和少样本三种设置 [abstract][S2.p2]。

quote: we evaluate GPT-3 on over two dozen NLP datasets, as well as several novel tasks designed to test rapid adaptation
claim: 论文在超过两打 NLP 数据集以及若干为测试快速适应而设计的新任务上评估 GPT-3，每个任务均在零样本、单样本和少样本三种条件下测试 [S1.p9]。

quote:
[S2.p2] We typically set $K$ in the range of 10 to 100
[S2.SS4.p2] the maximum amount allowed by the model’s context window, which is $n_{\mathrm{ctx}}=2048$ for all models
claim: 少样本设置中示例数 K 通常为 10 到 100，受模型 2048 token 上下文窗口限制 [S2.p2][S2.SS4.p2]。

quote: In Section 3.1 we evaluate on traditional language modeling tasks
claim: 评估覆盖语言建模与完形填空、闭卷问答、翻译、Winograd 风格任务、常识推理、阅读理解、SuperGLUE、NLI 以及算术、单词打乱、SAT 类比、新闻生成等合成与定性任务 [S3.p3]。

quote: GPT-3 achieves 81.5 F1 on CoQA in the zero-shot setting, 84.0 F1 on CoQA in the one-shot setting, 85.0 F1 in the few-shot setting
claim: GPT-3 在多项任务上取得较强结果：零样本 CoQA 达 81.5 F1，少样本达 85.0 F1 [S1.p11]；

quote: GPT-3 achieves 81.5 F1 on CoQA in the zero-shot setting, 84.0 F1 on CoQA in the one-shot setting, 85.0 F1 in the few-shot setting
claim: TriviaQA 少样本达 71.2%，在闭卷设置下相对微调模型达到当时最优 [S1.p11]。

quote:
[S3.SS1.SSS2.p1] in a zero-shot setting GPT-3 achieves 76% on LAMBADA, a gain of 8% over the previous state of the art
[S3.SS1.SSS2.p5] GPT-3 achieves 86.4% accuracy in the few-shot setting, an increase of over 18% from the previous state-of-the-art
claim: 在 LAMBADA 上零样本达 76%，比此前最优提升 8% [S3.SS1.SSS2.p1]，少样本达 86.4%，提升超过 18% [S3.SS1.SSS2.p5]。

quote: achieving 100% accuracy on 2 digit addition, 98.9% at 2 digit subtraction, 80.2% at 3 digit addition, and 94.2% at 3-digit subtraction
claim: 在需要即时推理的任务上，GPT-3 少样本在 2 位数加法上达 100% 准确率，2 位数减法 98.9%，3 位数加法 80.2%，3 位数减法 94.2% [S3.SS9.SSS1.p4]。

quote: mean human accuracy at detecting articles that were produced by the 175B parameter model was barely above chance at $\sim 52\%$
claim: 新闻生成方面，人类识别 GPT-3 175B 生成文章的准确率仅约 52%，接近随机水平 [S3.SS9.SSS4.p5]。

quote: we also find some tasks on which few-shot performance struggles, even at the scale of GPT-3
claim: 但论文也发现少样本在 ANLI、RACE、QuAC 等任务上仍表现不佳 [S1.p13]。

quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves
claim: 作者明确承认 GPT-3 在文本合成和若干 NLP 任务上仍有明显弱点，例如长段落中失去连贯性、自相矛盾，以及在“常识物理”类问题上存在困难 [S5.p2]。

quote: GPT-3 samples still sometimes repeat themselves semantically at the document level, start to lose coherence over sufficiently long passages, contradict themselves
claim: 在部分“比较”类任务上，GPT-3 单样本甚至少样本表现仅略好于随机，如 WiC 和 ANLI，以及部分阅读理解任务 [S5.p2]。

quote: our experiments do not include any bidirectional architectures or other training objectives such as denoising
claim: 结构上，论文只研究自回归模型，未包含双向架构或其他训练目标，这可能牺牲了在填空、回看比较内容等任务上的表现 [S5.p3]。

quote:
[S5.p4] scaling pure self-supervised prediction is likely to hit limits
[S5.p5] Another limitation broadly shared by language models is poor sample efficiency during pre-training
claim: 此外，预训练目标本身可能触及极限，且模型在预训练阶段样本效率较差 [S5.p4][S5.p5]。

quote: ambiguity about whether few-shot learning actually learns new tasks “from scratch” at inference time
claim: 作者还指出，少样本学习究竟是在推理时从零学习新任务，还是识别训练中已见过的任务，仍存在不确定性 [S5.p6]。

quote: In computer vision, however, convolutional architectures remain dominant.
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：在计算机视觉中，卷积架构仍占主导，而将自注意力用于图像的工作要么与卷积网络结合，要么保留卷积网络整体结构 [S1.p2]。

quote: Inspired by the Transformer scaling successes in NLP, we experiment with applying a standard Transformer directly to images, with the fewest possible modifications.
claim: 作者受 Transformer 在 NLP 中成功扩展的启发，尝试以尽可能少的修改，将标准 Transformer 直接应用于图像 [S1.p3]。

quote: We split an image into fixed-size patches, linearly embed each of them, add position embeddings, and feed the resulting sequence of vectors to a standard Transformer encoder.
claim: 方法上，作者将图像切分为固定大小的图像块，对每个图像块做线性嵌入并加入位置嵌入，把得到的向量序列输入标准 Transformer 编码器 [S3.F1]。

quote: Similar to BERT’s [class] token, we prepend a learnable embedding to the sequence of embedded patches
claim: 模型沿用 BERT 的做法，在序列前加入一个可学习的分类 token，其编码器输出状态作为图像表示 [S3.SS1.p2]。

quote: We note that Vision Transformer has much less image-specific inductive bias than CNNs.
claim: 作者指出，ViT 比 CNN 具有更少的图像特定归纳偏置，只有 MLP 层是局部且平移等变的，自注意力层是全局的 [S3.SS1.SSS0.Px1.p1]。

quote: we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
claim: 实验使用 ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet（1k 类、1.3M 图像）、ImageNet-21k（21k 类、14M 图像）和 JFT（18k 类、303M 高分辨率图像）进行预训练 [S4.SS1.p1]。

quote:
[S4.SS1.p1] we use the ILSVRC-2012 ImageNet dataset with 1k classes and 1.3M images
[S4.SS1.p1] its superset ImageNet-21k with 21k classes and 14M images, and JFT with 18k classes and 303M high-resolution images.
[S4.SS1.p1] We transfer the models trained on these dataset to several benchmark tasks: ImageNet on the original validation labels and the cleaned-up ReaL labels, CIFAR-10/100, Oxford-IIIT Pets, and Oxford Flowers-102.
[S4.SS1.p2] We also evaluate on the 19-task VTAB classification suite.
[S4.SS1.p2] VTAB evaluates low-data transfer to diverse tasks, using 1 000 training examples per task.
claim: 迁移评估包括 ImageNet 原始验证标签与 ReaL 标签、CIFAR-10/100、Oxford-IIIT Pets、Oxford Flowers-102，以及包含 19 个任务、每任务 1000 个训练样本的 VTAB 分类套件 [S4.SS1.p1][S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: We base ViT configurations on those used for BERT, as summarized in Table 1.
claim: 模型变体基于 BERT 配置，包括 Base、Large 和新增的 Huge，并用 ViT-L/16 等记号表示模型规模与输入块大小 [S4.SS1.p3]。

quote: When trained on mid-sized datasets such as ImageNet without strong regularization, these models yield modest accuracies of a few percentage points below ResNets of comparable size.
claim: 在中小规模数据集（如 ImageNet）上无强正则化训练时，ViT 的精度比同规模 ResNet 低几个百分点 [S1.p4]。

quote: The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks, while requiring substantially less computational resources to train.
claim: 但在大规模数据上预训练后，较小的 ViT-L/16 在 JFT-300M 上预训练后在所有任务上超过同样在该数据集上预训练的 BiT-L，且训练所需计算资源显著更少 [S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: The smaller ViT-L/16 model pre-trained on JFT-300M outperforms BiT-L (which is pre-trained on the same dataset) on all tasks, while requiring substantially less computational resources to train.
claim: 更大的 ViT-H/14 进一步提升性能，尤其在 ImageNet、CIFAR-100 和 VTAB 套件等更具挑战性的数据集上 [S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: the best model reaches the accuracy of $88.55\%$ on ImageNet, $90.72\%$ on ImageNet-ReaL, $94.55\%$ on CIFAR-100, and $77.63\%$ on the VTAB suite of 19 tasks.
claim: 最佳模型在 ImageNet 上达到 88.55%、ImageNet-ReaL 上 90.72%、CIFAR-100 上 94.55%、VTAB 19 任务套件上 77.63% 的准确率 [S1.p5]。

quote: First, Vision Transformers dominate ResNets on the performance/compute trade-off.
claim: 在性能与计算量的权衡上，ViT 优于 ResNet，达到相同性能约少用 2–4 倍计算量 [S4.SS4.p2]。

quote: Transformers lack some of the inductive biases inherent to CNNs, such as translation equivariance and locality, and therefore do not generalize well when trained on insufficient amounts of data.
claim: 作者指出，ViT 在中小规模数据集上训练时精度低于同规模 ResNet，因为 Transformer 缺少 CNN 固有的平移等变性和局部性等归纳偏置，在数据不足时泛化不佳 [S1.p4]。

quote: However, we note that pre-training efficiency may be affected not only by the architecture choice, but also other parameters, such as training schedule, optimizer, weight decay, etc.
claim: 作者还指出，预训练效率可能不仅受架构选择影响，也受训练计划、优化器、权重衰减等其他参数影响 [S4.SS2.p2]。

quote: Our initial experiments show improvement from self-supervised pre-training, but there is still large gap between self-supervised and large-scale supervised pre-training.
claim: 在自监督方面，作者初步实验显示自监督预训练相比从头训练有提升，但与大规模监督预训练之间仍有较大差距 [S5.p2]。

quote: Our initial experiments show improvement from self-supervised pre-training, but there is still large gap between self-supervised and large-scale supervised pre-training.
claim: 作者也承认，将 ViT 应用于检测和分割等其他视觉任务仍是待解决的挑战 [S5.p2]。

quote:
[abstract] do they answer such questions based on exposure to similar questions during training (i.e., cheating), or by genuinely learning to extract knowledge from sources like Wikipedia?
[S1.p5] leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer
claim: 论文要解决的问题是：语言模型回答事实性问题时，是基于训练中见过相似问题（数据污染/传统记忆），还是真正从维基百科等来源中提取知识 [abstract][S1.p5]。

quote:
[S1.p5] leaving it unclear whether the model answers questions like “Which city was Abraham Lincoln born in?” by extracting knowledge from Lincoln’s biography ( our focus) or if it encountered a similar (or same!) question during training and memorized the answer
[S1.p6] Given the challenges of conducting controlled experiments with internet data, we propose studying this question using well-controlled, synthetically generated data
claim: 作者指出，以往研究使用互联网预训练模型，无法区分这两种机制，因此需要可控实验来研究模型如何在训练中记忆知识并在推理时提取 [S1.p5][S1.p6]。

quote:
[S2.p2] The synthetic dataset, bioS, generates profiles for $N=100,000$ individuals.
[S2.p3] We generate a six-sentence biographical text entry for each individual, highlighting six distinct aspects. For diversity, each sentence is randomly chosen from approximately 50 distinct templates.
[S2.p4] We examine a “close-to-real” dataset produced by Llama.
claim: 作者构建了合成传记数据集 bioS（10 万个体，每人六句传记，每句从约 50 个模板中随机选择）和 Llama 生成的近真实数据集 bioR [S2.p2][S2.p3][S2.p4]。

quote:
[S2.SS1.p3] Here, we pre-train the language model from scratch on the BIO data, randomly sampling and concatenating them into 512-token sentences, separated by a standard <EOS> token. The model is then fine-tuned using half of the QA data and evaluated on the remaining half
[S2.SS1.p4] In mixed training, we train the model from scratch on all BIO data and half of the QA data.
claim: 采用两种训练方式：预训练+指令微调（先在传记上预训练，再用一半人的 QA 微调）和混合训练（同时用全部传记和一半人的 QA 训练） [S2.SS1.p3][S2.SS1.p4]。

quote: We propose two probing methods: position-based (P-probing) and query-based (Q-probing). Both methods employ simple, nearly-linear probes to extract personal attributes from the model’s hidden states.
claim: 此外，提出基于位置的探测（P-probing）和基于查询的探测（Q-probing）两种近乎线性的探测方法，以分析知识在隐藏状态中的编码位置和方式 [S5.p1]。

quote:
[S2.SS1.p1] We use a 12-layer, 12-head, 768-dim GPT2 (124M) or Llama architecture for pre-training on the bioS data, but a larger 12-layer, 20-head, 1280-dim GPT2 (302M) or Llama for the bioR data
[S2.SS1.p1] Only in Figure 2 when presenting a negative result, we tried a 12-layer 32-head 2048-dim GPT2 (682M).
[S7.p2] We call this modified model GBERT.
claim: 实验在 bioS 和 bioR 数据集上进行，使用 GPT2/Llama 架构（bioS 用 124M 模型，bioR 用 302M 模型），并额外测试了 682M 模型和 BERT 变体 GBERT [S2.SS1.p1][S7.p2]。

quote:
[S2.p6] QA accuracy is measured by the proportion of answers that exactly match the correct response.
[S3.p1] The model’s generative accuracy is then tested on the QAs from the remaining individuals ( ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$) to assess its out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization capability.
claim: 评估指标为 QA 生成准确率，测试集为未在训练中见过 QA 的个体（OOD 设置） [S2.p6][S3.p1]。

quote: We focus on three augmentations: adding multiplicity, introducing permutations, and repeating full names, typically found in internet data.
claim: 知识增强实验包括多版本（multi M）、句子打乱（permute）和重复全名（fullname） [S4.SS2.p1]。

quote: the OOD generalization accuracies are $86.6\%$ when mixed-trained on bioS single and $77.7\%$ for bioR single.
claim: 混合训练能使模型有效提取知识，在 bioS single 上 OOD 准确率达 86.6%，bioR single 上达 77.7% [S3.p2]。

quote: the model exhibits zero-zero QA accuracy on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$ for all finetuning parameters.
claim: 但仅预训练传记后微调 QA，模型在测试集上准确率为零，即使模型规模远大于数据量、个体被暴露上千次 [S4.SS1.p2]。

quote: Pretraining on a dataset where each person has 5 diverse biography entries (i.e., different wording, sentence shuffling) boosts the QA fine-tune accuracy (on ${\mathcal{P}_{\mathsf{test}}}$) from 9.7% to 96.6%.
claim: 知识增强能大幅提升提取能力，例如每人 5 个多样化传记条目将 QA 微调准确率从 9.7% 提升到 96.6% [S4.SS2.p3]。

quote: The QA finetune accuracy correlates closely with Q-probing accuracy, indicating that the “degree to which the attribute is directly linked to the person’s name” is a crucial factor for effective knowledge extraction.
claim: 探测实验表明，知识增强使属性几乎线性地编码在人物姓名 token 的隐藏状态中，Q-probing 准确率与 QA 微调准确率高度相关 [S5.SS2.p4]。

quote: Introducing celebrity data boosts the minority group’s QA accuracy (e.g., from 4.4% to 86.8% for the bioS data).
claim: 此外，加入“名人”数据能显著提升“少数群体”的 QA 准确率（如 bioS 从 4.4% 到 86.8%） [S6.p4]。

quote: Unless the knowledge is a standalone word or of independent words (like month, day, year), extracting knowledge after MLM pretraining might prove challenging, if not totally impossible.
claim: 双向模型（GBERT）在 MLM 预训练后难以提取知识，除非知识是独立单词 [S7.p8]。

quote: Using synthetic data allows for greater control over the training and fine-tuning of models, which is essential for understanding how different data sources impact the internal mechanisms of transformers.
claim: 作者指出，本文主要使用合成和 Llama 生成的数据，可能无法完全反映真实互联网数据的复杂性 [S8.p1]。

quote: We leave the follow-up question to study logical reasoning or manipulation on knowledge to a separate paper.
claim: 此外，研究聚焦于事实性知识，未涉及逻辑推理或知识操作，后者留待后续工作 [S1.p6]。

quote: Since we only apply GBERT to the bioS data family to demonstrate a negative result, we utilize the same architecture size as GPT2-small.
claim: 对于双向模型，实验仅在 bioS 数据家族上进行以展示负面结果 [A8.p1]。

quote: However, entanglement remains largely unexplored at the highest accessible energy scales.
claim: 论文旨在最高可及能标上观测量子纠缠，此前纠缠在最高能标上仍基本未被探索 [abstract]。

quote: Recently, the heaviest fundamental particle known to exist, the top quark, was proposed as a new laboratory to study quantum entanglement and quantum information.
